messages:
Mina: quick RFC follow-up: proposing a lightweight "grace" handshake for staged evict so allocators can opt into a short delay before forced demote. sketch below.
Tom: high level sounds good. do you mean state on the alloc or per-allocation token?
Mina: per-allocation token plus an allocator capability bitset. three micro-phases: SOFT (hinted, no migration), DRAIN (best-effort migrate), FORCE (hard demote). alloc advertises support for SOFT/DRAIN.
Priya: best-effort raises thrash risk for KV caches. how do we avoid flip-flopping between pin/unpin?
Mina: include retry_budget + backoff windows in the token. also expose metrics: drain_attempts, drain_success_rate, last_drain_age. evictor shortens window if success_rate < 50%
Ava: also add fragmentation_hint from allocator: fragmentation_score (0..100) and reclaimable_bytes. evictor picks targets maximizing reclaimable_bytes * fragmentation_score
Tom: allocator residency descriptor proposal: {capabilities, fragmentation_score, reclaimable_bytes, pinned_flags}. keep small and stable.
Jason: note: hosted vs dedicated defaults should differ. hosted: small grace window (100-200ms). dedicated/private: configurable larger (up to seconds)
evict-bot: FYI: when coop not supported evictor falls back to LRU per current behavior :thumbsup:
Priya: rollout: feature-flag header `X-Evict-Mode: staged-coop` and start as opt-in A/B. prefer not to change ABI until we validate.
Mina: rollout plan: (1) ABI token + opt-in header, (2) telemetry + gates, (3) sync compaction hint, (4) tenant soft-budget guardrails.
Ava: edge-case: CUDA ptrs held by user (external refs) -> UNMOVABLE_PIN. need small set of stable error codes: COOP_WOULD_BLOCK, COOP_UNMOVABLE, COOP_DEMOTED.
Tom: agree on stable codes. SDKs should surface COOP_WOULD_BLOCK so apps can choose to retry or fall back to compute-on-host path.
Jason: ops asks for tenant_soft_budget to cap aggregate soft-grace memory per tenant to avoid DOS by tenants hoarding grace windows
Priya: suggest config path: evictor.policy.tenant_soft_budget = <bytes> and a hosted default of 256MB per tenant
Mina: also adding GET /internal/debug/allocators/<pool>/snapshot for early rollout diagnostics (internal only).
Ava: one more: compaction interactions. if we delay demote too long we reduce compaction opportunities. maybe evictor should schedule periodic compaction windows where grace is suspended
Mina: good idea. add compaction_window boolean to policy so compaction epochs override grace tokens.
Tom: I'll pair with Mina on the ABI today. can someone mock allocator descriptor in the runtime tests?
Priya: I can add unit tests for gating logic and metrics thresholds.
Mina: thanks — I'll draft PR and post link here when ready
Mina: (later) draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/12345 — still WIP, comments welcome
